t: This is Chepstow Villas, a residential street in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Mary Ann Mantell died here in 1869. She was a fossil collector and illustrator, and the wife of the palaeontologist Gideon Mantell. She is credited, though it's disputed, with finding the first Iguanodon fossils, and her pen and ink sketches went into her husband's scientific description of the animal. The landscape gardener Henrietta Phipps also lived here. She worked for the borough for many years and is said to have shaped its look.
